dayclose_action_pause: Stop at the next chunk boundary
dayclose_action_running: The request is processing and can take several minutes. Do not repeat the action, wait for it to finish.
dayclose_action_unknown: The status is unknown because the connection failed. Reload to see the latest result, and do not repeat the action before the status is readable.
dayclose_business_date_missing: No business date exists. Set the first one with ctl bootstrap on the server before a close can be started here.
dayclose_code_301: A teller session is still open. Close it (count the cash) in the app.
dayclose_code_302: A teller session closed with unbalanced cash. Resolve the difference first.
dayclose_code_303: A vault top-up request is still undecided. Ask a checker to decide.
dayclose_code_304: A suspense account has a balance. Cancel this run, then post a correcting journal.
dayclose_code_305: The trial balance is out of balance. Do not continue, investigate the journals because this indicates data damage.
dayclose_code_306: The subledger balance could not be read. Run ctl reconcile-deposits, then investigate.
dayclose_code_307: An account has no balance row. Run ctl reconcile-deposits, then investigate.
dayclose_code_308: The subledger total differs from the GL. Investigate the difference, do not paper over it with an unexplained journal.
dayclose_code_309: The post-close check ran while the date was not CLOSING. Do not continue, check platform.business_date.
dayclose_code_310: A journal was posted after the date was frozen. Cancel the run, inspect that journal, then close again.
dayclose_code_311: An account in a gate parameter is unknown or inactive. Fix the parameter through maker-checker.
dayclose_code_312: The account list in a gate parameter is empty. Fill it because an empty list disables the gate.
dayclose_code_320: The balance snapshot could not be written because of a database error. Check the error, the task retries automatically.
dayclose_code_321: The balance snapshot differs from the journals. Compare the source=ledger report with balance_snapshot for that date.
dayclose_code_322: The trial balance is out of balance at snapshot time. Do not close the books.
dayclose_code_323: The GL period could not be read because of a database error. Try resume once the database is healthy.
dayclose_code_324: It is month end but no GL period ends today. Create the period first.
dayclose_code_325: Closing the period failed because of a database error. The period stays OPEN, check the log, then resume.
dayclose_code_326: A cash session is open inside the period being closed. Cancel the run, close the session, then run again.
dayclose_code_327: A period changed state during the close. Check ledger.period.
dayclose_code_328: The previous period is still OPEN. Close the previous period first.
dayclose_code_330: The accrual account list could not be read because of a database error. The task retries automatically.
dayclose_code_331: The account's product version lacks an accrual attribute (rate, day-count basis, or rounding scale) or it is malformed. Complete the product version bindings.
dayclose_code_332: The account date or business date is invalid (corrupt data).
dayclose_code_333: The accrual journal could not be written: the accrual posting rule is missing or ambiguous, or the business date's period is already closed.
dayclose_code_334: An accrual for this account and date already exists. The task is supposed to be idempotent; investigate the duplicate write.
dayclose_code_335: Cumulative interest decreased because the principal shrank without an accrual correction. Check the account movements.
dayclose_code_336: The interest amount exceeds the numeric range. Check the principal and the product rate.
dayclose_code_337: The accrual row could not be stored because of a database error. The task retries automatically.
dayclose_code_340: The maturity account list could not be read because of a database error. The task retries automatically.
dayclose_code_341: A matured time deposit has no roll-over instruction (aro_instruction). The data is corrupt; fill in NONE, PRINCIPAL, or PRINCIPAL_AND_INTEREST before resuming.
dayclose_code_342: An account, maturity, or business date is invalid (corrupt data).
dayclose_code_343: A matured time deposit has no active savings account in the same branch to receive the principal or interest. Open the destination account, then resume the close.
dayclose_code_344: The maturity journal could not be created: the posting rule is missing or ambiguous.
dayclose_code_345: The maturity transfer could not be stored, or the account balance changed while it was being processed. Retry; investigate concurrent movements if it repeats.
dayclose_code_346: A time deposit has an unknown roll-over instruction (aro_instruction). The data is corrupt; the task does not guess.
dayclose_code_347: The renewal term is invalid: the maturity date is not after the account opening date. Fix the account dates before resuming.
dayclose_code_348: The maturing account has no balance row (missing cache). Reconcile/rebuild the balance first; the deposit is not closed so the principal is not lost.
dayclose_code_349: Maturity processing is more than one term late: the new maturity date has already passed. A second ARO cycle is not supported yet (O-109); resolve it manually before resuming.
dayclose_code_350: The dormant account list could not be read because of a database error. The task is retried automatically.
dayclose_code_351: The dormant threshold parameter (deposit.dormant.after_months) is missing or is not a valid number of months. Set the institution parameter, then resume.
dayclose_code_352: Account data is corrupt: unknown account status. Fix the row before resuming.
dayclose_code_353: The dormant status could not be saved because of a database error. Retry; no money moved.
